name: atlas_permitted_clinics
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.atlas_permitted_clinics(permission_name text)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_id uuid, clinic_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select c.organization_id, c.id
  from public.clinics c
  join public.memberships m on m.organization_id = c.organization_id
  where m.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and m.active
    and (m.role in ('owner', 'administrator')
         or ((m.clinic_id is null or m.clinic_id = c.id) and coalesce((m.permissions ->> permission_name)::boolean, false)));
$function$

name: has_clinic_permission
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_clinic_permission(target_org uuid, target_clinic uuid, permission_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.memberships m
    where m.organization_id = target_org
      and m.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and m.active
      and (
        m.role in ('owner', 'administrator')
        or (
          (m.clinic_id is null or m.clinic_id = target_clinic)
          and coalesce((m.permissions ->> permission_name)::boolean, false)
        )
      )
  )
$function$
